appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.thisDeviceHelp: Light or dark is a per-device choice; Auto follows the device setting.
appearance.fontHelp: Applies to the whole board, for everyone.
appearance.addGoogleFontHelp: Downloaded once and stored on your server — the board never calls out to Google when someone opens a page, and it keeps working offline.
appearance.tvThemeHelp: How the /tv wall display looks. This is household-wide, not per device.
appearance.tvThemeNoLocation: No location set, so this falls back to a 7am–7pm window. Set a weather location for real sunrise and sunset.
appearance.adminOnly: Ask an admin to change the household font and colors.

about.title: About this board
about.help: If a change you expected isn't here, check this build date — it tells you whether the server was actually rebuilt. The same details are at /api/health.

language.title: Language
language.label: Board language
language.help: Applies to the whole board, for everyone. Dates, times and amounts follow the language you pick.
language.adminOnly: Ask an admin to change the board language.
